Ask AxiomCode

Talk to the service — by typing, or by voice. Ask what a certificate means, have your code checked, check a certificate, see your usage.

Who decides what: the assistant explains, but it cannot issue, change, soften, or predict a verdict. Every verdict on this page comes from the same verification service as the API — rendered from the service’s own response, never from the assistant’s words. When the service cannot answer, this page says so instead of guessing.

No key yet? Email hello@axiom-code.com — keys with 10 free trial verifications are issued free. Your key is sent only to the AxiomCode API. It is not stored unless you tick the box, and then only in this tab’s session storage.

Check a certificate instead

Prefer forms? The web verifier and certificate checker do one job each. Prefer code? The REST API and MCP are the same service in machine shape.
